hero.summary: With {years} years of experience, I drive technical decision-making and take full ownership of system design and delivery, from product requirements to CI/CD, monitoring and AI-assisted delivery with agents, RALF cycles and fast design-to-code iterations.

skills.title: Skills
skills.aiNote: Deeply comfortable with AI-assisted engineering: Codex, Claude Code, agent workflows, RALF cycles, review loops and design-to-code iteration. I use these tools as engineering leverage, not as a substitute for architecture.

salmon.description: Built a loan application from scratch. Made a major contribution to the Salmon portal redesigns 1.5 and 2.0, visible on the homepage and product landing pages. Worked closely with stakeholders and multiple designers to shape a CMS architecture with reusable blocks, making it easier to assemble product pages. Improved business metrics through performance work, including Redis request caching (SLA ~99.9%). Developed a debug page for finding blocks, analytics events, network requests, GitOps keys and integrations from analytics to Kafka and Redis. Built a scalable MUI-based UI Kit, documented it in Storybook and extended Strapi with custom plugins.

reelmotion.description: Developed a client betting platform where users could place real-time bets and watch event outcomes live. Integrated payment flows from banking providers to crypto, built complex UI components, protected payment reliability with unit and E2E tests, and improved Lighthouse performance scores from 68 to 93.

crimtan.description: First deep experience working with an international team: the products, documentation and day-to-day communication were in English. Migrated core functionality from AngularJS to Angular (2+). Improved backend form engine typing and optimized tree path resolution, significantly increasing stability and availability, with 1.5x performance improvements confirmed under stress testing.

javaMentor.description: Engineered a web application for IT education with a strong focus on usability and performance. Cut bundle size by half and improved TTI by 20%. Designed a modular modal factory leveraging React Portal and independent widgets. Supported role-based platform features and migrated legacy JavaScript code to TypeScript.

kata.description: Led and scaled mentorship for hundreds of students, conducting in-depth code reviews and regular 1-on-1 sessions. Guided learners through their full educational journey, advising on modern web development practices and helping design effective, individualized learning plans.
